subject: Recap & MAP: Sundown AI discovery — technical & ops milestones
raw_messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emily Barnes <emily.barnes@sundown.ai>, Rajesh Nair <rajesh.nair@sundown.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & MAP: Sundown AI discovery — technical & ops milestones

Thanks again for a productive conversation this morning — appreciate the context on inference cost sensitivity and the peaks you see during nightly batch scoring. Quick recap of the key pain points and tangible goals we heard, and a suggested mutual action plan (MAP) to get to pilot-ready:

Pain points we captured:
- Large 95–99th pctl latency spikes during batch windows and concurrent requests (especially for embeddings).
- Cost unpredictability across dev vs. prod; need to shave unit cost without sacrificing quality.
- Lack of observability for model drift and per-route quality regressions.
- Procurement and security checks (SOC2, data residency, audit logs) will be gating for Prod.

Stated goals (customer):
- P95/P99 latency SLAs: P95 < 120ms, P99 < 350ms for chat and embeddings under target concurrency.
- Reduce per-token inference cost ~30–40% via batching + quantization while preserving quality.
- VPC or private deployment option for regulated workloads; SOC2 Type II evidence for procurement.

Proposed MAP (high-level milestones & owners) — please confirm owners/dates or propose changes:
1) Security & compliance packet (SOC2 summary, data residency write-up) — Owner: Karthik (Redwood) / Emily (Sundown) — target: 2027-04-09
2) Technical deep dive: model shape, seq length distribution, perf baseline & profiling — Owner: Marissa (SE) / Rajesh (Sundown) — target: 2027-04-06 10:00 PT
3) Pilot environment provisioned (staging VPC, keys, test data tunnel) — Owner: Redwood infra + Sundown infra — target: 2027-05-03
4) Pilot run & success criteria measurement (latency, cost, quality) — Owner: Joint — target: 2027-05-31
5) Procurement & contract execution (SOW + MSA) — Owner: Sundown procurement + Redwood sales — target: 2027-05-20
6) Go-live (production cutover) — target: 2027-06-15

Attachments: I attached a draft MAP spreadsheet (sundown_map_v1.xlsx) with milestones, owners, and a rough resource estimate. Also included a one-page technical checklist.

Next steps I propose:
- Emily/Rajesh: confirm procurement contact and that the dates above are realistic for your side (Gloria? please confirm).
- Marissa: will send a 4/6 deep-dive agenda and pre-read by EOD Monday.
- Karthik: I will share the SOC2 summary and a short pricing ballpark for a 6–8 week pilot.

If this looks correct, please reply with any edits to owners/dates and we’ll lock the calendar.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer

- Procurement contact: Gloria Chen (gloria.chen@sundown.ai) — I looped her on the procurement thread; Gloria will own contract/finance questions.
- SOC2: please send the SOC2 Type II report or at minimum the control matrix + auditor summary. We have a strict vendor assessment for data residency and key handling.
- Can you provide an indicative pricing range for a 6–8 week dedicated pilot (instances + support)? Ballpark is fine for now; procurement needs to bake numbers into the review.

Thanks Emily — appreciate the fast turnaround and the RFP extract. Quick replies inline and next steps:

- Procurement: noted — please loop Gloria (confirmed). We’ll route contracting via standard SOW + MSA; I’ll flag the 5/25 procurement target and keep our contracts team aligned.
- SOC2: I’m attaching a SOC2 summary and the controls matrix for Redwood (redwood_sundown_map_v1.pdf). Full Type II report requires an NDA; happy to get that to Gloria once NDA is in place.
- Pricing: preliminary pilot estimate (6–8 weeks, dedicated pilot config with staging VPC + 4x A100-equivalent capacity + 24/7 on-call SE coverage): estimated range $11,000–$15,000 / month. Final pricing will depend on exact throughput and retention windows — we’ll firm this in the SOW.
- Technical deep dive: 2027-04-06 at 10:00 PT works for our team. Agenda (short): current infra and model shapes; perf profiling artifacts we need; staging provisioning checklist; success metrics. Marissa will lead the S.E. portion.

I’ve attached the MAP as a PDF and pushed the editable spreadsheet to the shared Drive link (see HubSpot/Drive links below).

Thanks all — looking forward to lining up the deep-dive.
